purpose: Monitor public coin-news headlines and measure subsequent coin/BTC behavior as exogenous research context without using news to retune frozen order-flow rules.
research_rules: Do not infer causality from headline timing and subsequent price movement.
Do not make news a strategy filter unless a separate specification is frozen before later validation data is inspected.
Do not use news outcomes to retune discovery-v1 thresholds.
Do not store article bodies, credentials, API keys or account data.
Incomplete future horizons remain incomplete rather than being imputed.
